title: The Legend of the Mystical Ninja - King Ryukyu's Secret
description:
This is an upbeat song from Mystical Ninja on the SNES. It has an Asian flute sample for the majority of the melody through out, with a synth break toward the end.

Recently featured in the level "Sunset Breeze" in Grand Poo World 2
